# AI Briefing

> Daily intelligence on the AI industry for developers, founders, investors, and technical leaders.

AI Briefing is a daily news service covering the full AI ecosystem: labs, infrastructure, hardware, finance, law, policy, geopolitics, open-source, and the industries being disrupted. Published every weekday at https://aibriefing.dev

## Content

- **Daily Stories** — https://aibriefing.dev/stories
  Curated AI news articles with editorial summaries. Covers Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Meta AI, Mistral, xAI, and the broader ecosystem.

- **Weekly Editorial** — https://aibriefing.dev/main
  In-depth editorial analysis of the week's defining AI theme. Includes multiple analytical lenses, featured stories, and editor's tool picks.

- **Community Pulse** — https://aibriefing.dev/community
  Top Hacker News threads, Reddit discussions, and viral tweets from the AI community — ranked by engagement.

- **Media** — https://aibriefing.dev/media
  Curated AI videos from major labs, researchers, and creators.

- **Trending Tools** — https://aibriefing.dev/tools
  Most-starred AI libraries, frameworks, and GitHub repos ranked by developer momentum.

- **Search** — https://aibriefing.dev/search
  Full-text search across all stories, videos, tools, and community items.

- **Archive** — https://aibriefing.dev/archive
  Historical daily briefings.

## Story pages

Individual stories are at https://aibriefing.dev/story/{story_id}/
Each story includes a headline, editorial summary, source URL, vendor/lab attribution, and publication date.

## Languages

Content is available in English and Hebrew (toggle in the site header).

## Coverage scope

AI Briefing covers:
- Model releases and benchmarks (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, etc.)
- Funding rounds, valuations, and M&A
- Regulatory and legal developments (copyright, antitrust, safety)
- Open-source releases and GitHub trending repos
- Community reactions and developer sentiment
- Infrastructure, chips, and compute (NVIDIA, AMD, custom silicon)
- Enterprise AI deployments
- Safety and security incidents
